text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian President Arafat due in Hebron today.
- Prime Minister Netanyahu: Golan is not negotiable.
- U.S. envoy Dennis Ross: Israel will decide extent of redeployments.
- Palestinian man dies in PLO's Bethlehem prison; autopsy reveals possible torture.
- Defence Minister Mordechai to Syria: come to the negotiations table.
- Tension in Hebron ahead of Arafat's visit today.
